combo_label: Pets & Petcare × Fireworks & Bonfire Night × Vikings

entries.clue: Leap suddenly on a scrap of string trailed across the carpet
Fjord-riven kingdom many a westbound raider called home
Straw-stuffed likeness wheeled round on a cart and then burnt on top of the pile
German dog developed to bolt badgers, better known as the sausage dog
Cheek-stuffing rodent that runs a squeaky wheel all night
Round wooden disc with an iron boss, locked rim-to-rim into a living wall
Rush upward with a hissing sound, trailing a tail of sparks
Bare rock in the sea that could open a hull; the Norse named it
Cook in dry heat, as chestnuts are done in a pan on the coals
Cow-shed built into one end of a Norse farm hall
Where kept birds get mesh walls and room enough to fly
Fireworks mounted on a framework to spell a word or draw a picture
